reason: 一次arXiv本文はPhytium/Cambricon MLU370上でViT推論のhead sparsification、embedding圧縮、INT8/mixed precision、operator fusionとsingle-card pipelineを評価し、全処理latency 18.7ms・Jetson AGX Xavier比2.89xを報告する。一方、対象modelはViTとrobotics operatorでLLM実験はなく、NeuPIMs系統へのhardware接続は間接的。
title: Research on Intra-Chip Fusion Deployment and Optimization of Embodied Intelligence Business Operator NPU
